constraints: Replace only Chart.yaml dependencies whose repository is the retired incubator URL (https://charts.helm.sh/incubator or https://kubernetes-charts-incubator.storage.googleapis.com).
Look up the chart name in Helm's relocation lists for the maintainer's new repository; if none exists, consider adopting the chart rather than pinning the archive.

steps.instructions: Change the reported dependency's repository URL to the chart's new location from the relocation list (or another maintainer-published repository), and set version to a release published there.
steps.title: Point the dependency at a maintained repository

steps.instructions: Update every other Chart.yaml dependency that still names the retired incubator repository URL.
steps.title: Align other Chart.yaml dependencies

verification.purpose: Fetch the dependency from the new repository and refresh Chart.lock.
Render the chart and validate the output against Kubernetes schemas.

rule.replacement: The chart's new maintained repository (see Helm's stable-repo-charts-new-locations list), or adopt the chart yourself

sources.title: Helm community: stable repository charts — new locations

rule.summary: The Helm project retired the incubator chart repository with the same timeline as stable: on 2020-11-13 CI was disabled and no further pull requests were accepted, and downloads were redirected to a read-only archive that receives no bug fixes or security patches. The Helm Chart Repository Deprecation Update states those dates and recommended actions.
rule.title: Helm incubator chart repository is end of life
